|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/corporalkensaric.html</ref>

This man is the bane of the Imperials, in constructed or [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Boosted Draft format. Sure, he's deploy 2 for power 2, ability 2 and forfeit 4, but his gametetxt is the real kicker. Deploy +2 for opponents characters, vehicles and starships to same location with another scout. This is like [[Goo Nee Tay]] with a forfeit value!

An invaluable addition to almost any deck where you want to slow the opponents beatdown force! Card

Combos: All opponents characters are +3 to deploy to the Corporal's site, but if they are Imperials of ability 3 or more, make that +5! Ouch! Put him at the Swamp and that's +3 Force to battle and no reacting. Force choke! Urrrkkk! A destiny draw and a forfeit of 7 all up. Additionally, when the Imperials deploy elsewhere to avoid the deploy cost, they won't even be able to react or [[Elis Helrot]] over. And their Biker Scouts will be forfeit - 2 also.
